name: Glayden (FI)
description:
Glayden is a Helsinki-based singer, songwriter and DJ releasing music independently through BELOW0, carrying the cold melancholy and fragile optimism of his city in everything he makes.

His work finds unexpected connections between genres and subcultures that rarely share the same space, sitting at the intersection of earworm songwriting and experimental textures. A Children of Bodom sample meeting a vocal refrain borrowed from Madonna is just one thread in a patchwork quilt mapping the terrain of love, addiction and hard won hope.

This concert is supported by Liveurope and the Norwegian Art Council. Liveurope is a pan-European initiative to support venues in promoting emerging European talent.
